notes.title: 🛎️We're announcing a new game!🛎️
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Welcome back, Fantasy Gamers! ✨[/h2]

[h3]We’ve been dying to show you what we’ve been working on… [b]And the time has finally come[/b]. Get ready for a journey full of secrets and fulfilled fantasies...🔥[/h3]

[h2][url=https://2ly.link/26Hhu]Hotel Lust[/url][/h2]

[url=https://youtu.be/i2vtkIoXaSM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458754/66ff5577ee1307db04e1c64e5a99126b8039073f.png[/img][/url]

[h2][i]Here’s a small taste of what’s to come…[/i][/h2]

[h3][i]Your boring life as a hotel receptionist takes an unexpected turn when the oldest employee reveals a dark and tempting secret: a network of hidden peepholes connecting all the rooms in the building. What starts as mischief turns into an obsession... Every guest brings their own desires, secrets, and fantasies. You decide whether you only watch… or take part.[/i][/h3]

[h3]

[b]And that’s not all! The hotel rooms hide more than you can imagine… 👀[/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644940][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458754/903c11fac1bc87c7fea25263071f7ebe7beb26ba.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b][h2]Meet our irresistible guests:[/h2] [/b]

[b]💋 Mya Landon [/b]– The rebellious wife in search of passion.

[b]🎭 Henny Ritcher[/b] – A devoted cosplayer who seduces through character.

[b]😈 Lilith[/b] – Spoiled, provocative… and dangerous.

[b]🔞 Irina Petrov[/b] – A shameless Russian exhibitionist with zero filters.

[b]😳 Soyeon Lee[/b] – A shy girl looking to blow off steam.

[b]💘 Lana Valentine[/b] – A full-blown sex goddess who’s tried it ALL… and wants more.[/h3]

[h2][b]Did one of the girls catch your eye? 🔥[/b][/h2]

[h3]Then add the game to your [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644940]Steam Wishlist[/url][/b] to be the first to know when she checks in 👀.

You’ll be the first to know when we open the doors. 🔑

[/h3]

[i][h3]And of course, you can join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/2vXV4Z2kge]official Discord[/url][/b] or follow us on [url=https://x.com/Fantasy_GStudio][b]Twitter/X[/b][/url] to discuss theories, favorite scenes, or just say hi. We always reply! 😘[/h3][/i]

[h2]With love,

The Fantasy Games Team.[/h2]

notes.title: New Year... New Game! Ever Hotter: Multi-story and Scorching Secrets!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Fantasy Gamers! 🥳

In our first post of the year, we want to share [b]two big announcements[/b].

As you know, our goal is to create [b]games that are increasingly complete and original[/b], exploring new and creative paths in adult game genres.

[h2]Our Next Project[/h2]

On that note, our first big news is that we’ve published the [b]store page for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403310/]Ever Hotter[/url][/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403310/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/701c35e968d7c2d09d9df83fcd7eb61588af13d5.png[/img][/url]

Not only is it the longest AVN we’ve worked on, but it also features a [b]more complex (and fun!) script[/b], packed with [b]choices that will shape your gameplay experience[/b].

Last but not least, it’s a [b]VERY spicy story[/b]: the writer had to deal with his “two heads” to finish writing it. 😉

If it caught your attention, [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] so Steam will notify you on launch day, and you can take advantage of the release discount!

[h2]What Happened with SpyLens?[/h2]

Some of you might have wondered about the release of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285790/]SpyLens[/url][/b], our first AVN to feature [b]game mechanics that complement the narrative gameplay[/b].

In short: [b]we couldn’t get it validated in time[/b] to launch before the busy holiday period. December is a hectic month, and many people aim to publish at specific dates, which affected the validation process.

The good news is that [b]it’s launching next week![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285790/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/c75d786efbaeb6f206e8879d1984fcac9cf2e2c9.png[/img][/url]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285790/]SpyLens[/url][/b] will be released on [b]January 16[/b]. We’d love to hear your [b]review if you enjoy it[/b], and your [b]feedback[/b] on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/2vXV4Z2kge]Discord channel[/url][/b].

Building on the success of the bundle we created for the launch of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200590/]Axxx[/url][/b], we’re creating a [b]special new bundle[/b] so you can purchase [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285790/]SpyLens[/url][/b] with an [b]additional discount[/b] on top of the launch discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3285790/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/e10b78f7852620589d4e9b5cb3a8eecbb55cb51b.png[/img][/url]

Follow us on our Steam page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45205779-Fantasy-Games-Studio/]Fantasy Games[/url], so we can keep making bigger and better projects!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45205779-Fantasy-Games-Studio/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/830a0462b7630597d903f0f145848f33e33878e2.png[/img][/url]

Thank you, as always, for your support. It inspires and motivates us to keep developing new projects. 💟

Hugs,
The Fantasy Games Team

notes.title: Our Next Game! Axxx - Taught and fucked
notes.content:
Hello Fantasy Gamers!

We’re very excited to write our first post to all of you. First of all, thank you so much for supporting us by purchasing Hentai Girls Gallery, our first project.

Your support has motivated us to continue developing new projects 💟 but before we talk about that, we’d like to briefly introduce ourselves.

[h2]Fantasy Games[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/648dfe453aeb8348289debab7541c87d2a21a61d.png[/img]

We’re a small H-game studio of 2 members, with previous experience in the video game industry.

Our goal is to keep developing H-games, moving on to more ambitious projects step by step, with determination.

We want to expand the H-game universe with unseen elements and more creative approaches, and we would love to have your support to help us grow and make it possible.

[h2]Our Next Step[/h2]

That is, our next project: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200590/]Axxx - Taught and fucked[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200590/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/d97770906277ae8845f337f6c8e3d95af252f8b6.png[/img][/url]

We believe this is a special proposal, as it’s an AVN (Adult Visual Novel), but [b]it’s not based on Renpy[/b]; it’s built using our own system.

What does this give us? The ability to [b]add any feature[/b] we can imagine! As well as improving existing ones, going beyond the typical features of a Renpy-made game.

Additionally, as we create more AVNs in the future, we’ll take advantage of these developments to expand features and retroactively [b]add them to the rest of our AVNs[/b].

By the way, our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45205779-Fantasy-Games-Studio/]Fantasy Games Steam page[/url] is live! If you’re not following us yet, now is the perfect time. We’re just getting started.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45205779-Fantasy-Games-Studio/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/830a0462b7630597d903f0f145848f33e33878e2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]And Finally, a Gift[/h2]

As a token of our appreciation for your support, we’re creating a special bundle so you can get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200590/]Axxx - Taught and fucked[/url] at a special launch discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3200590/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121193/d6d69fa5e0e68b9093402570bd91f20bacaa09f1.png[/img][/url]

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist so Steam will notify you on launch day, and you can take advantage of the offer!

Best regards,
The Fantasy Games Team
